newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch seek Russian pre-revolution bonds payment.
newsitem.headline: Dutch seek Russian pre-revolution bonds payment.

text.p: The Dutch lobby group for small investors VEB said on Tuesday it had asked the Dutch authorities to take steps through which Dutch holders of Russian pre-revolution bonds can be compensated.

The VEB said Russia was reported to have struck a deal with the French authorities in November last year to pay for Russian bonds issued before the revolution of 1917. Compensation was estimated at $380 million, VEB said, quoting press reports.
It said it had requested the Dutch ministers of foreign affairs and finance to take action so that a similar deal could be struck for Dutch investors.
"A similar deal to the one in France would imply a compensation for Dutch investors of about $52 million or nearly 100 million guilders," the investors lobby said.
In 1917, Dutch investors held Russian bonds with total nominal value of about 950 million guilders, it added.
